source.author: cic
source.text: nam etsi non sus Minervam ut aiunt, tamen inepte quisquis Minervam docet.
source.text_original: nam etsi non sus Minervam ut aiunt, tamen inepte quisquis Minervam docet.
source.text_english: For although a pig does not teach Minerva, as the saying goes, still whoever teaches Minerva is acting foolishly.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: haec non sus, ut aiunt, Mineruam, sed ingredientem pelagus amicum amicus monui malens a te facultatem meam quaeri quam uoluntatem, ut, in quo ego lapsus sum, tu firmo pergeres gradu.
reuse.text_original: haec non sus, ut aiunt, Mineruam, sed ingredientem pelagus amicum amicus monui malens a te facultatem meam quaeri quam uoluntatem, ut, in quo ego lapsus sum, tu firmo pergeres gradu.
reuse.text_english: I, your friend, have advised this, not like a pig, as they say, teaching Minerva, but as one entering the sea: I would rather that my ability be sought from you than my goodwill, so that in the point where I have stumbled, you might go on with firm step.
